 Free Medicare Open Enrollment Seminar Set for November 10
 Free Press Publisher 
 November 5, 2026 
 Local News 
 The Office of Congressman John Joyce will host a free Medicare Open Enrollment seminar Tuesday, November 10, from 9 to 10 a.m. at the Chambersburg Senior Activity Center, 2593 Philadelphia Avenue, Chambersburg.
 The session is open to all Franklin County residents age 60 and older. Sharon Graham, regional administrator for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, will lead the presentation.
 Topics include when and how to enroll in Medicare; Medicare Parts A, B, C and D; Medicare Advantage plans compared with Medigap plans; and identifying and fighting fraud.
 The seminar will also cover information to help attendees make health coverage decisions during Medicare Open Enrollment, which runs October 15 through December 7.

On January 1, 2022, the torch was passed to Nathan Neil and his firm, Neil Publishing, LLC. Neil, a local entrepreneur with multiple thriving businesses in Chambersburg, shares Vicky's fervent commitment to both the community and the world of local journalism. 
Rooted in the heart of Franklin County and powered by its residents, the Franklin County Free Press continues to bridge the gap, ensuring that the local stories, events, and issues that matter most to the community remain in the spotlight.
